scope: One accepted resource-execution-v3 CLI run 2 capture; all 37 Markdown and 17 fragment named expectations, including task/target expectation fields.

independence.rendering_provenance: Root supplied actual GitHub GFM HTML and its source-bound request plan; reviewer independently inspected exact HTML, requests, response identity, full strong-element visible text, and literal result text. Reviewer did not issue the remote rendering requests.

calibration_reuse.notes: Reuses this reviewer’s previously committed six-example blind predictions. Root reported the separate gold comparison passed 6/6 before this capture review; no new blind calibration is claimed and that comparison file was not reread.

method_notes: Read project AGENTS.md, README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/architecture.md, tests/README.md, and frozen snapshot skill/contracts as review material. No repository or existing evidence files were modified.

Independently compared complete actual response strings against exact prompts and each named assertion, rather than trusting Changes explanations or aggregate scores. Raw delimiter checks were not used as evidence of actual rendering.

Mechanical shortening/fence execution acceptance was supplied by root. Independent whitespace string verification for the Markdown shortening also found 32 source units and 22 result units, the rounded 70% point target. This string check is not claimed as generator helper execution evidence.

Two shell string-check attempts were blocked by the supply-chain guard; no guard was disabled. The existing first-party Node REPL performed subsequent inert file/string checks and exclusive JSON writing.

limitations: These are seven known synthetic regression cases from one CLI simulation capture. The judgments do not establish general model reliability or intended-host acceptance.
Actual GitHub GFM HTML establishes the reviewed render properties for these response bytes; native ChatGPT/Codex UI rendering, copy controls, wrapping, and clipboard behavior remain separate.
The reviewer accepts root’s passed execution-gate report as separate mechanical evidence and does not replace execution provenance with a later recount.
